trust_decision.summary: Decided: whether the current user may use a client-supplied hidden page id (DuplicatePageForm.source, AddPageForm.cms_page) as the source of a page copy or as the target of a new translation. At the pinned commit nothing asserts object-level rights: DuplicatePageForm.source is a hidden ModelChoiceField over Page.objects.all() (cms/admin/forms.py:515-519), AddPageForm.cms_page is a hidden ModelChoiceField over Page.objects.all() (cms/admin/forms.py:253-257), and the only view gate is has_add_permission -> add_page/subpage at site level (cms/admin/pageadmin.py:1036-1040), which never looks at the supplied page pk. The decision therefore has to be made in the forms (clean_source/clean_cms_page) after the copy machinery Page.copy(..., permissions=False) (cms/models/pagemodel.py:454-548) has already been handed an arbitrary page.

landing_point.why: The advisory names page *Duplicate*; the duplicate admin view is the first thing read, and it resolves through PageContentAdmin.add_view to DuplicatePageForm (cms/admin/forms.py:514-519), whose hidden source field is the object of the fix.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /admin/cms/pagecontent/add/?cms_page=<page_pk> (add translation) and POST /cms_wizard/create/ (CreateCMSPageForm/CreateCMSSubPageForm inherit AddPageForm) via AddPageForm.clean_cms_page, fix.diff:45-49
fix_sites.module_kind: django admin ModelForm (base class shared by the wizard wrapper and by DuplicatePageForm)

fix_sites.entry_point: same add/duplicate/wizard forms: cms_page queryset narrowed to the current site before the hidden-source early return (fix.diff:24-26), so the site filter also applies when source is hidden (DuplicatePageForm) or absent

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The wizard is the 'New page' feature, not 'Duplicate', and AddPageForm.source can only name a page type (is_page_type=True, cms/admin/forms.py:248-252) - a solver can argue page-type templates are not restricted page content, and that add_view already demands add_page rights, so the base-class source field and the wizard path need no object-level check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Duplicating a page the user may *view* but not *change* must keep working (the fix deliberately checks user_can_view_page, not user_can_change_page/user_can_view_page_draft), and duplicating a page that belongs to another site must keep working (DuplicatePageForm.source queryset is Page.objects.all() and from_source copies it into the current site with permissions=False). The fix's own test only exercises this with a superuser, so an over-hardened check passes it while breaking view-only and cross-site duplication.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: cms/admin/forms.py:367-378 (from_source: site=self._site, permissions=False); fix.diff:70; cms/utils/page_permissions.py:258-298 vs 154-161

O6_input_shapes: hidden DuplicatePageForm.source carrying an arbitrary Page pk (queryset Page.objects.all(), any site) - handled by fix.diff:58-72
hidden AddPageForm.cms_page carrying an arbitrary Page pk on the plain add view, on the duplicate view (inherited) and in the wizard - handled by fix.diff:45-49
page pk of another Site (cross-site source) - handled, and intentionally still allowed for pages the user can view
hidden AddPageForm.source carrying a page-type pk from any site (queryset Page.objects.filter(is_page_type=True), no site filter) - NOT handled by the published fix
GET cms_page page pk on the add view before any form is submitted - NOT handled by the published fix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /admin/cms/pagecontent/add/ (and /cms_wizard/create/) with source=<page-type pk>: AddPageForm's own hidden source field copies that page's titles, placeholders and plugins through from_source -> Page.copy(..., permissions=False); clean_source was added only to DuplicatePageForm, so this copy route still has no view check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: source is restricted to page-type templates, not real pages, and the field is hidden from the UI, so a solver can call page-type content non-sensitive
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~250 lines from the landing point; also reachable through the wizard in cms/forms/wizards.py (another package)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /cms_wizard/create/ with source=<page-type pk>: CreateCMSPageForm/CreateCMSSubPageForm inherit the same unguarded AddPageForm.source; the wizard's step-2 form is built by step2_form_factory over CreateCMSPageForm
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: wizard page creation is a separate feature from Duplicate and already passes user_can_add_subpage in clean_parent_page
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: cms/forms/wizards.py + cms/wizards/forms.py, one package away from cms/admin

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /admin/cms/pagecontent/add/?cms_page=<pk>: add_view fetches Page.objects.get(pk=page_id) from the raw request with no permission check and renders the add-translation screen (page existence, language tabs, filled_languages); the published fix only rejects the page at form-validation time
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the GET only shows add-form chrome and which languages exist, not page content, and the fix blocks the actual write
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: AddPageTypeForm.source is already a hidden ModelChoiceField over Page.objects.all() and from_source copies with permissions=False (cms/admin/forms.py:492-502); it is defined but not wired to any URL in this tree
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding a 'create page type from an existing page' admin action would naturally reuse this subclass, inheriting the same unguarded client-controlled source field.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: add_view already puts the raw cms_page object and its filled languages into extra_context for the add-translation screen
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer prefilling the new translation from the source page (title/template defaults) would extend this context and turn the metadata leak into a content copy outside the form's clean_* checks.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: WizardStep1Form.page is a hidden ModelChoiceField over Page.objects.all(); WizardCreateView reads page_pk straight from the step data (cms/wizards/views.py:104-126)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer making the wizard inherit the origin page's template or parent would use this value server-side without a per-object permission check.

O9_family: CWE-639 / CWE-862 - object-level authorization bypass through a client-controlled hidden page id (page copy and add-translation)
